additionalProperties.description: Properties of the object. Contains field @type with type URL.

etag.description: Optional. `etag` is used for optimistic concurrency control as a way to help prevent simultaneous updates of an alert from overwriting each other. It is strongly suggested that systems make use of the `etag` in the read-modify-write cycle to perform alert updates in order to avoid race conditions: An `etag` is returned in the response which contains alerts, and systems are expected to put that etag in the request to update alert to ensure that their change will be applied to the same version of the alert. If no `etag` is provided in the call to update alert, then the existing alert is overwritten blindly.

endTime.description: Optional. The time the event that caused this alert ceased being active. If provided, the end time must not be earlier than the start time. If not provided, it indicates an ongoing alert.

Csv.description: A representation of a CSV file attachment, as a list of column headers and a list of data rows.

failedAlertStatus.description: The status details for each failed `alert_id`.

successAlertIds.description: The successful list of alert IDs.

customerPrimaryDomain.description: The primary domain for the customer.

successAlertIds.description: The successful list of alert IDs.

failedAlertStatus.description: The status details for each failed `alert_id`.

BatchUndeleteAlertsResponse.description: Response to batch undelete operation on alerts.

assignee.description: The email address of the user assigned to the alert.

updateTime.description: Output only. The time this metadata was last updated.

severity.description: The severity value of the alert. Alert Center will set this field at alert creation time, default's to an empty string when it could not be determined. The supported values for update actions on this field are the following: * HIGH * MEDIUM * LOW

etag.description: Optional. `etag` is used for optimistic concurrency control as a way to help prevent simultaneous updates of an alert metadata from overwriting each other. It is strongly suggested that systems make use of the `etag` in the read-modify-write cycle to perform metadata updates in order to avoid race conditions: An `etag` is returned in the response which contains alert metadata, and systems are expected to put that etag in the request to update alert metadata to ensure that their change will be applied to the same version of the alert metadata. If no `etag` is provided in the call to update alert metadata, then the existing alert metadata is overwritten blindly.

status.description: The current status of the alert. The supported values are the following: * NOT_STARTED * IN_PROGRESS * CLOSED

customerId.description: Output only. The unique identifier of the Google Workspace account of the customer.

md5HashMessageBody.description: The hash of the message body text.

attachmentsSha256Hash.description: The `SHA256` hash of email's attachment and all MIME parts.

date.description: The date of the event related to this email.

sentTime.description: The sent time of the email.

md5HashSubject.description: The MD5 Hash of email's subject (only available for reported emails).

subjectText.description: The email subject text (only available for reported emails).

messageBodySnippet.description: The snippet of the message body text (only available for reported emails).

link.description: Link to a Security Investigation Tool search based on this entity, if available.

name.description: Human-readable name of this entity, such as an email address, file ID, or device name.

values.description: Extra values beyond name. The order of values should align with headers in EntityList.

AccountWarning.description: Alerts for user account warning events.

email.description: Required. The email of the user that this event belongs to.

loginDetails.description: Optional. Details of the login action associated with the warning event. This is only available for: * Suspicious login * Suspicious login (less secure app) * Suspicious programmatic login * User suspended (suspicious activity)

stringValue.description: Value if the type is string

intValue.description: Value if the type is integer

timestampValue.description: Value is the type is a timestamp

boolValue.description: Value if the type is boolean

isInternal.description: If `true`, the email originated from within the organization.

maliciousEntity.description: The entity whose actions triggered a Gmail phishing alert.
